title: Retrieval teams for crashed triangular craft
summary: Steven Greer tells of Retrieval teams for crashed triangular craft, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I know a man two different people who've been on the retrieval teams of the triangular ones.

plain: A UFO researcher, Steven Greer, says he knows two different people who served on retrieval teams, crews said to recover crashed craft, for the triangular ones, meaning triangle-shaped unknown craft. If true, it would mean such craft have come down and been quietly collected.
